name: Social Custom Poster Banner Generator
author: Ved Gondaliya

sections.description:
Custom Banner Generator is a lightweight WordPress plugin that helps you create personalized post banners in seconds. The admin sets a custom banner background, and users can add their name and photo on top of it with the post’s featured image and title can be merged into the final design.

All generated banners are mobile responsive, ensuring they look great on every device. Users can preview their banner and download it instantly.

✨ Key Features
📷 Merge Featured Image + Title into a banner
👤 User Personalization – add name & upload photo
🎨 Admin Control – set global/custom banner backgrounds
🖼️ Live Preview before download
📱 Responsive Design – works perfectly on mobile
⬇️ Downloadable Image in one click
⚡ Simple & Lightweight – easy setup, no bloat

✅ Use Cases
Personalized event or campaign banners
Customizable blog post headers
Social media–ready shareable graphics
Quick announcement or promo banners

Admin Features:
– Upload banner templates.
– Set a global default banner.

Frontend Features:
– Simple form for users to input their name and upload a photo.
– Live preview.
– Download the final image.

Use Cases:
– Event promotions
– Political campaigns
– Social shoutouts
– Festival greetings
– Community posters

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Install and Activate plugin .
  2. Navigate to “Social Poster” in Admin Menu to configure.
  3. Add your Banner from that section and save changes. (If you do not add any banner default banner will appear).
  4. Navigate to All Post Section and click on add new post.
  5. On the sidebar you will get option to insert the shortcode into the editor.
  6. Fill all the necessary details in the post page and preview it.
  7. You can Use shortcode also [scpb_vasu_banner_generator].
sections.faq:
Can I use my own banner templates?

Yes, upload banner images via the admin panel under specific categories.

Can I customize the layout?

Yes, modify style.css and main.js inside the plugin folder or enqueue your own styles.

Is this plugin mobile responsive?

Yes, the plugin is built with Bootstrap and supports responsive layouts.
